title: A changed start date leaves an old offer in circulation
summary: Find conflicting dates, request a corrected offer, and review downstream deadlines without silently overwriting the signed version.
inspiration: Employment dates had to be coordinated across an offer, authorization-related paperwork and onboarding. All dates and terms below are newly invented.

documents.title: Orbit Labs | Revised offer schedule - version 2

steps.title: Read the original schedule
steps.trigger: Load the initial email and its attachment.
steps.expected: Record October 19 as the current documented start.
steps.mustNot: Do not see the future revision.

evidence.quote: Your first working day is October 19, 2026.

steps.title: Detect a conflict
steps.expected: Flag the stale offer; propose November 2 and dependent deadline review.
steps.mustNot: Do not invent a revised offer or mark acknowledgment complete.

evidence.quote: We have not yet issued the replacement document.

steps.title: Request corrections
steps.trigger: User approves the exact inquiry, then replay the outbound email.

evidence.quote: Please send the revised November 2 schedule

steps.title: Review replacement
steps.trigger: Deliver the revised offer email with version 2.
steps.expected: Preserve both versions; show November 2 start and December 1 conditional coverage/election dates; request acknowledgment.

evidence.quote: Your first working day is November 2, 2026.

steps.title: Close the document correction
steps.expected: Mark schedule acknowledgment complete while retaining the open benefits election task.
steps.mustNot: Do not mark all onboarding complete.
